title: Remove old .githooks leftovers and keep eval artifacts 7 days
body:
## Why

No pre-commit hook has run since the move to `.vite-hooks` (f774aa2). That is how #143 merged a formatting error that broke main CI and needed #144. Separately, eval run artifacts used GitHub's 90-day default retention and filled the account-wide Actions storage quota (43 artifacts, 1.17 GB).

## Root cause (hooks)

The shared git config still had `core.hooksPath = .githooks`, a folder that no longer exists. The vite-plus `install()` (run by `prepare` → `vp config --no-agent`) does not overwrite another `core.hooksPath`. It prints `core.hooksPath is already set to ".githooks", skipping` and exits 0, so nobody saw it.

The setup itself is fine. `prepare` runs on install and sets `core.hooksPath = .vite-hooks/_`. It also writes the gitignored dispatcher `.vite-hooks/_/` in each checkout. A fresh clone gets it from `pnpm install`. A new T3 worktree gets it from `vp i` in `scripts/setup-worktree.ts`, because a new worktree has no `node_modules`. So no code change is needed there. Only clones that still hold the old `.githooks` value need a one-time local fix:

```sh
git config --unset core.hooksPath && vp config --no-agent
```

I applied that fix to the shared config on this machine and ran `vp config` in the main checkout and every worktree. The main checkout's `node_modules` predates vite-plus, so run `vp i` there before its hook can find `vp staged`.

Proof in this worktree (probes reverted):
- Staged `export const   probe = {a:1,\n    b:2}`. The hook ran `vp check --fix` and committed `export const probe = { a: 1, b: 2 };`.
- Staged a drift in `.agents/skills/comprehende/SKILL.md`. The hook ran `check:skill --staged` and rejected the commit.

## Changes

- Delete `scripts/install-git-hooks.js`, `src/git/hooks.test.ts`, and the stale "Mirrored in scripts/install-git-hooks.js" comment in `src/git/exec.ts`. The test only proved that the old installer sets a relative `.githooks` path that works in linked worktrees. vite-plus now owns that behavior. Nothing else references these files.
- `.github/workflows/eval.yml`: add `retention-days: 7` to `Upload eval run`. `if: always()` stays, because failed runs are the useful ones.

## Review

Comprehende review: https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/pr/145/

## Verification

- `vp check`: pass
- `vp test run src/git/exec.test.ts`: pass
- `tsc --noEmit` (root and `scripts/`): pass
- No eval smoke run: this PR does not touch `skills-next/`, `src/schema/`, or `src/review/`.

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> CI artifact retention and deletion of unused hook-install code; no runtime product or auth paths change.
> 
> **Overview**
> Removes the obsolete **`.githooks` installer** and its worktree-focused test now that **vite-plus** owns `core.hooksPath` via `.vite-hooks`. Also trims a stale cross-file comment in `src/git/exec.ts`.
> 
> The **eval workflow** now sets **`retention-days: 7`** on uploaded `eval/runs` artifacts (down from GitHub’s 90-day default) to cut Actions storage use; upload still runs **`if: always()`** so failed runs keep their outputs.
